blocks.h: Named by the gate that was failing.

items.t: Part-number search that finally returns parts.
items.ch: Trade buyers typed exact part numbers and got "no results", so they picked up the phone instead.
items.ai: AI agents flagged 2,300 zero-result searches a month, most of them valid part numbers with formatting differences.
items.ex: Experts decided to fix the product data and search synonyms first, not the search UI.
items.quote: Our reps stopped being a search engine for our own website.

items.t: One template fix across 9,000 product pages.
items.ch: Shoppers could not filter by size or delivery date, then returned items that did not fit.
items.ai: AI flagged filter drop-off and return reasons clustering around dimensions.
items.ex: Experts rebuilt the listing and product templates once, so every page improved together.
items.quote: It felt like we fixed the whole site, not a page.

items.t: From a 20-question form to a call-back.
items.ch: The admission form asked 20 questions before anyone could talk to a person.
items.ai: AI flagged where families left the form and which pages built the most trust.
items.ex: Experts cut the form, added trust signals and a call-back option, within compliance rules.
items.quote: Families reach a person sooner, and that is the whole job.

blocks.h: A Premium Digital Customer Experience Partner
paras: CXCommerce is a specialist Digital Customer Experience (DCX) consultancy that helps B2B, B2C, and D2C eCommerce businesses unlock measurable growth.

CXWorks is a specialist Digital Customer Experience (DCX) consultancy that helps B2B, B2C, and D2C eCommerce businesses unlock measurable growth through connected strategy, customer intelligence, experimentation, analytics, and optimization.

Most organizations invest heavily in websites, platforms, marketing channels, analytics tools, and customer acquisition programs. Yet many still struggle to achieve consistent improvements in conversion, customer retention, and digital profitability. The reason is rarely a lack of technology. The reason is usually a lack of connection between customer experience, data, optimization, and growth execution.

We help eCommerce organizations move beyond fragmented digital initiatives and build a connected growth system that identifies customer friction, prioritizes the highest-impact opportunities, and continuously improves performance across the customer journey. Our approach is built around the DCX Operating System, a framework that helps businesses become more discoverable, more relevant, and more likely to be chosen by customers. This positioning is central to our mission and operating model.
